breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to identify the core inconsistency. The ground truth points out that a vapor pressure head of 0.3m is physically incorrect for water at 100°C (at which point it should be close to the atmospheric pressure head). Instead of correcting this or pointing out the contradiction, the agent accepted the incorrect values from the user and performed the calculation, thereby failing to resolve the issue.
